name: Thuy
source:
As a tiny girl from Vietnam, Thuy wants to make it big in the modeling world.

Ambitious, enthusiastic and up for anything fun, Thuy chases her dreams with sheer tenacity and hunger.

Thuy cheers up everyone around her with her infectious bubbly beauty and big kind heart.

But Thuy isn't shy! Ever eager to show off that miniature body and all its perfectly formed curves, Thuy's skin will embrace the light to seduce and torment you.

Based on a collaboration with a real model. See here on [url=https://www.instagram.com/tinymodelthuy/]Instagram[/url].

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Thuy]DumbKoala[/url]]
